0022600108.text: The Bulls (1-1, on a W1 streak, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) host the Wizards (1-1, on an L1 streak, 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East), with both teams having played two games so far this season. Chicago has won all three of its meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 119-108 road win in Washington on April 9, 2026, and no games have been played between the teams yet in 2026-27. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring) and Noa Essengue (day-to-day, head, game-time decision), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip, pinched nerve), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision.
